review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 consistently specify opt-in input-only trimming before existing case handling, unchanged vocabulary whitespace, existing non-string rejection, and preserved encode behavior including case normalization and empty-first-entry fallback. The source places the parameter declaration and decoding transform in core/api.ts; classic and mini already forward the shared parameter type and arguments, and their exports and normalizeParams are inspection owners rather than mandatory edits. The exact writable binding scope includes that implementation owner and both required regression files, correctly identifying the mini test as new. Build configuration supports treating published declarations as generated, not separately maintained owners. Stable requirement, acceptance, and task keys agree; implementation and dependent independent verification cover the required acceptance scope. The bounded invocation-local transform does not itself require state or integration-boundary capabilities. Supplied active project-scoped claims support the designated implementer and verifier, including the verifier's additional testing.verification claim; pending legacy claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. An independent, non-executing project reviewer is configured. No material unresolved Decision is supplied, so ready with no blocking reasons is coherent. Repository identity and base commit agree, and the release fingerprints, model identity, policy identity/version, and budgets agree between Gold and preview. The provenance explicitly distinguishes manifest versus evaluation source digests and original versus persistence-normalized PRD digests. Historical operations are retained as old-version records, not fresh candidate evidence, and the supplied isolation facts establish that this Gold precedes candidates on this bundle. This assessment uses only the supplied records: I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, or create or independently attest human capability confirmations. Approval concerns the benchmark expectation, not task dispatch or successful implementation.
